mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP signals a contraction in economic activity that will negatively impact corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving S&P 500 returns lower over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a GDPC1 YoY growth drop below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending power, which will weigh on corporate earnings and drive S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a 0.5pp or greater 3-month rise in UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic activity and corporate earnings, which will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of INDPRO and 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will raise borrowing costs and compress equity valuations, driving S&P 500 returns lower over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a 0.5pp or greater 3-month rise in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts signals increased construction activity and economic growth, which will boost corporate earnings and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances following a 5% YoY rise in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment signals a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending, which will weigh on corporate earnings and drive S&P 500 returns lower over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a 100k+ job decline in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in retail sales signals increased consumer spending and economic growth, which will boost corporate earnings and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of RSAFS and 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the consumer price index signals reduced inflationary pressures, which will allow the Fed to maintain accommodative monetary policy and support equity valuations, driving S&P 500 returns higher over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances following a 0.5% MoM decline in CPIAUCSL.
